audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Pantheon on all seven rows; content and packet read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: Comet Spear reaches only 575 and Shield Vault 600, so levels 1-3 belong to a champion painting from outside both. 4-5 and 6 are genuinely contested — Mortal Will empowerment and Grand Starfall's 5500 range give him map agency — and Hwei's item burst retakes it after.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match the packet and content chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text named the ultimate 'Grand Skyfall'. There is no such ability.
audit.why: Pantheon's R is Grand Starfall, 180/165/150 seconds, 5500 range.
audit.corrected: Renamed and given its real range and cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Pantheon's W and E swapped throughout — 'closing the gap with E leap', 'his W block can absorb one key spell', 'block a key spell with W and leap in with E'. Aegis Assault (E) is the block; Shield Vault (W) is the dash-stun.
audit.why: Riot's W text: dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them, 600 range, 13/12/11/10/9. Riot's E text: sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly, 22/21/20/19/18.
audit.corrected: Every W/E reference re-pointed with the right names, ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Aegis Assault is a CHANNEL, so any CC ends it, and it blocks damage only from the FRONT.
audit.why: The kit flags Aegis Assault as channel (interruptible — any CC cancels it) and untargetable/shield, and Riot's text says invulnerable to damage from the front. Hwei's EE fear and EQ root both cancel a channel, which converts his single strongest defensive window into a 22-second hole. Painting into a set Aegis Assault instead throws the whole rotation onto the shield.
audit.corrected: Stated in tradeBad, phases[2].why, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18, Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8, Grand Starfall 180/165/150.

edits.before: Pantheon's Comet Spear gives him real poke range, but his all-in relies on closing the gap with E leap, and your E fear shuts that down if you land it first. You should be winning trades through levels 1-3 as long as you don't stand still and eat spears for free. Levels 4-5 stay competitive as his damage output and shield-block timing get sharper, so respect his all-in windows rather than only trading passively.
edits.after: Comet Spear gives him poke out to 575, but his all-in needs Shield Vault to close the last 600, and your EE fear shuts that down if you land it first. You win trades through levels 1-3 as long as you don't stand still and eat spears for free. Levels 4-5 stay competitive as Shield Vault falls to 10s and Aegis Assault to 19s, so respect his all-in windows rather than trading passively.

edits.before: Level 6 is genuinely even - Grand Skyfall lets him abandon the lane to make plays elsewhere on the map, which can either relieve pressure on you or set up a bigger play for his team, so it's a map-wide skill check rather than a lane-decisive spike. Keep poking when he's on cooldown and be ready to punish an all-in attempt with your fear, since his W block can absorb one key spell if timed well. Ward for his global ultimate threat once he's 6.
edits.after: Level 6 is genuinely even - Grand Starfall reaches 5500 and lets him abandon the lane to make plays elsewhere, which can relieve pressure on you or set up a bigger play for his team, so it's a map-wide check rather than a lane-decisive spike. Keep poking on his cooldowns and punish the all-in with fear: Aegis Assault is a channel, so any CC ends the block. Ward for the 180s ultimate once he's 6.

edits.before: You maintain the ranged poke advantage into the late game as long as you respect his ability to block a key spell with W and leap in in with E for a quick trade. Your combo still out-damages his kit at range, so keep him at arm's length rather than letting him get a free all-in window. Overall your kit answers his all-in with fear disruption better than his kit answers your poke.
edits.after: You keep the ranged poke advantage late as long as you respect Aegis Assault blocking a key paint from the front and Shield Vault closing 600 for the trade. Your combo still out-damages his kit at range, so keep him at arm's length rather than handing him a free all-in window. Your fear answers his engage better than anything he owns answers your poke.
